test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3571e5493e529443a557ed8a5aec478933d295bcfa0656c62a71caa8cfb629c0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**From figure 1 to figure 2 and figure 3 to figure 4:**

 
• Corner letters are shifting their position in clockwise direction.
 
• And middle letters interchange their position.

**From figure 2 to figure 3 and figure 4 to figure 5:**

 
• Top three and middle letter shift their position in anticlockwise direction.
 
• Added a new letter/ number in Bottom middle position in each figure.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46febb242f5e52bdb386bf315ec66482fd67444368b7d8c67d7fd7b7b4d6edc4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a090b44c80a67837c375f35547625b8a7c6af6f307a2f3d2b5b6c0639728587.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
